generic_lessons: A protected table scan does not protect later growth reads; an optional hint must contain the entire read chain.
Reject the whole optional hint after malformed or incomplete inputs instead of adopting the already collected prefix.
Compose independent score hints so a food-associated row outside the shortage gate does not erase the amenity hint.
Update every version consumer before starting discovery; importing an old function body can preserve its rejection after the file changes. Freeze sources through the final complete check.
Read-only scoring on an old runtime verifies native data shape, not new controller execution or game effects.
